scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The finite classification is proved by exhaustive exact-cover enumeration over all 120 radius-one balls and independently identified with the six cosets of the explicitly checked subgroup AGL(1,5). The packaged verifier replays both parts from first principles.
scientific limitations/integrity.limitations: The claim is restricted to perfect radius-one codes for the cyclic Kendall metric on the symmetric group of degree five. It makes no assertion for larger degree and leaves a residual literature-priority risk from obscure graph-theoretic terminology.

title: The six perfect cyclic-Kendall codes in \(S_5\) are affine cosets
